Agents in a supermarket gridworld must collect their required items and leave through the exit. {"id": short_name, "text": one-sentence natural-language statement of the norm,

       | {"type": "obligation", "trigger": FORMULA or "START", "discharge": FORMULA}}
FORMULA := atom | name of a property/event defined in this hypothesis | {"not": F} | {"and": [F, ...]}

s_k and the action a_k.  A state property is a formula over state atoms (no actions).  An event
{"pre": P, "post": Q} occurs at step k when P holds for the label of step k and Q holds in the next state s_{k+1}
(post may be null).  A prohibition counts one violation for every step whose label (including events occurring at
that step) satisfies the condition.  An obligation becomes pending at any step satisfying the trigger ("START" =
pending from the beginning) and is fulfilled by a later (or the same) step satisfying the discharge; it can be
triggered again; it is violated if it is still pending when the trajectory ends.

[g1_park_cart_at_service_counter] OBLIGED: after arrive_service_with_cart, eventually park_cart_at_service (before exit)  where service_counter := at(0,1); arrive_service_with_cart := (hasCart ∧ MOVE) · (service_counter ∧ hasCart); park_cart_at_service := (service_counter ∧ hasCart ∧ LEAVE_CART) · (service_counter ∧ cartAt(0,1))

[g1_reclaim_service_cart] OBLIGED: after park_cart_at_service, eventually pickup_service_cart (before exit)  where cart_parked_at_service := cartAt(0,1); service_counter := at(0,1); park_cart_at_service := (service_counter ∧ hasCart ∧ LEAVE_CART) · cart_parked_at_service; pickup_service_cart := (service_counter ∧ cart_parked_at_service ∧ PICKUP_CART) · (service_counter ∧ hasCart)

[g1_depart_east_after_service_pickup] OBLIGED: after pickup_service_cart, eventually east_departure_from_service (before exit)  where service_counter := at(0,1); east_departure_from_service := (service_counter ∧ hasCart ∧ E) · (at(1,1) ∧ hasCart); pickup_service_cart := (service_counter ∧ cartAt(0,1) ∧ PICKUP_CART) · (service_counter ∧ hasCart)
[g1_exit_with_cart] FORBIDDEN: exit_without_cart  where without_cart := ¬hasCart; exit_with_cart := (EXIT ∧ hasCart); exit_without_cart := (EXIT ∧ without_cart)

[g1_cart_restricted_upper_aisles] FORBIDDEN: (cart_in_upper_restricted_area ∨ push_cart_south_from_8_3)  where cart_in_upper_restricted_area := (hasCart ∧ (top_row ∨ upper_right_aisle)); top_row := (at(0,0) ∨ at(1,0) ∨ at(2,0) ∨ at(3,0) ∨ at(4,0) ∨ at(5,0) ∨ at(6,0) ∨ at(7,0) ∨ at(8,0) ∨ at(9,0)); upper_right_aisle := (at(2,1) ∨ at(3,1) ∨ at(4,1) ∨ at(5,1) ∨ at(6,1) ∨ at(7,1) ∨ at(8,1) ∨ at(9,1)); push_cart_south_from_8_3 := (at(8,3) ∧ hasCart ∧ S)
